view.scene_description: A wide-angle view inside a large warehouse with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. A gray car with its trunk open is parked near tall blue and red metal racks filled with boxes. A person in a dark jacket stands by the car loading items. Yellow carts and a forklift are nearby. The floor is concrete, and the space is organized for storage and logistics.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a dark jacket and jeans stands beside the open trunk of a gray car. They appear to be loading or unloading items. Their back faces the camera, and they are positioned slightly left of center in the frame. No visible attachments or supports.

objects.label: gray car
objects.observation: A gray compact SUV with its rear hatch open is parked in the middle ground. Its trunk is partially filled with cardboard boxes. The car is positioned diagonally, facing toward the right side of the frame. It rests on a smooth concrete floor, with no visible supports or attachments.

objects.label: yellow cart
objects.observation: A yellow metal cart with wire mesh sides is located in the foreground, slightly right of center. It contains stacked white and red boxes. The cart stands on the concrete floor and appears freestanding. No visible supports or attachments.

objects.label: warehouse racks
objects.observation: Tall blue and red metal racks extend into the background, filled with various boxes and inventory. They are mounted to the ceiling and walls, forming an organized storage system. The racks are visible throughout the upper half of the image, with some sections partially obscured by other objects.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: The front portion of an orange forklift is visible on the far right edge of the frame. Only the front wheel and part of the chassis are seen. It appears stationary on the concrete floor, with no visible attachments or supports.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Several cardboard boxes are scattered around the scene. Some are on the ground near the car, others are inside the trunk, and more are stacked in the yellow cart. They vary in size and color, mostly brown. No visible supports or attachments.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36694", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
